tagline: Our mission is to revolutionize commerce globally.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Payment Volume (TPV) is the primary metric for PayPal's network growth and momentum, directly reflecting consumer and merchant adoption globally.

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume
kpis.explanation: Total Payment Volume — total value of payments processed.
kpis.description: TPV reaches $1.79 trillion in 2025, up 7% from 2024, supported by an increase in active accounts and integrated services.

kpis.name: Active Accounts
kpis.explanation: Number of accounts that have made a transaction during the last 12 months.
kpis.description: PayPal had 439 million active accounts as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 1% compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transaction fees, financial services, and partnerships
kpis.description: Net revenues reach $33.2 billion in 2025, up 4% compared to 2024, driven by TPV growth and credit-related revenues.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating Margin — operating profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves from 17% in 2024 to 18% in 2025, despite higher marketing expenses and credit losses.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating Income — profit from core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating profit reaches $6.1 billion in 2025, up 14%, driven by revenue growth and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Number of Payment Transactions
kpis.explanation: Total number of payments made on the platform.
kpis.description: The number of transactions declines by 4% to 25.4 billion in 2025, while TPV increases, indicating a rise in average transaction value.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income amounts to $5.2 billion in 2025, up 26%, supported by a lower corporate tax burden.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last six reported fiscal years (10-K)

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 3 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.13 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 2.5% last year.

stories_kpis.name: Operating Margin
stories_kpis.description: Operating margin increases from 17% in 2024 to 18% in 2025, after remaining stable at 17% in 2023.

stories_kpis.name: Net Revenues
stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transaction fees, financial services, and partnerships
stories_kpis.description: Net revenues increase from $29.8 billion in 2023 to $31.8 billion in 2024, then to $33.2 billion in 2025.
stories_kpis.signal: Steady revenue growth over three years.

ai_positioning.summary: PayPal is integrating AI and machine learning into its operations and products to enhance customer experience and efficiency. The company is investing in these technologies to innovate and remain competitive in the payments market.
evidence: The Company is investing in artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance its products and services.
Artificial intelligence and machine learning are critical to our strategy for developing new products and improving existing ones.
We are leveraging AI and ML to personalize customer experiences, detect fraud, and optimize our operations.
